messages:
Nate B.: Scheduling Northcliff Dedicated rollout for 2026-05-20 21:30 UTC. Requesting infra + ops final signoff. Model pin: rdlw-3.2-qat. Release notes: https://redwood.in/release/northcliff-2026-05-20

deploybot: New deploy request D-2430 created by Nate B.
Target: dedicated/northcliff-prod.
Plan: canary 4% (25m) -> 30% (15m) -> 70% (20m) -> 100% (gradual).
Runbook: https://redwood.in/runbooks/D-2430
```
monitors: p95, 5xx_rate, customer_errors
auto_hold: {5xx_rate: 0.5%, p95: 260ms}
rollback: pin_previous: rdlw-3.1-stable
```

Ivy L.: Staging checks green on quantized build, p95 172ms. One small note: token alignment adjustment may change some short-answer completions slightly. CS notified.

Marco D.: Ops confirmed window and on-call rotation. Please add dedicated.pin in the release config to avoid agent auto-updates. OpsBot, block KMS rotations 20:30-22:30 UTC.

OpsBot: KMS calendar locked for 2026-05-20 20:30-22:30 UTC (request id KLOCK-78). No key rotations during window.

Hannah C.: Adding a trace sampling bump to 40% during canary to catch regressions. Also recommend increasing kvcache prewarm to 25% of fleet before traffic shift.

Nate B.: Updated deploy config:
```
release_id: D-2430
model_pin: "rdlw-3.2-qat"
dedicated.pin: true
trace_sample_canary: 40%
kv_prewarm_pct: 25%
```

deploybot: Canary started at 2026-05-20T21:30:00Z (canary cb-5078). Monitoring active.

Ivy L.: Canary metrics: p95 178ms, 5xx_rate 0.08%, customer_errors 0.01%, cost +1.4%. Looks healthy. +1 to proceed to 30%.

Marco D.: Rolling to 30% now. Ops watching logs and traces. Auto-rollback thresholds reiterated: 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 > 260ms for 10m. Manual rollback if customer_errors > 0.8% or cost > 8%.

deploybot: Ramp to 30% complete. Next automatic ramp in 15m.

Hannah C.: 30% observation window passed. No anomalies in traces. Proceeding with 70% ramp.

deploybot: Ramping to 70% (auto).

Ivy L.: 70% steady. p95 184ms, 5xx_rate 0.12%. Holding 15m then gradual to 100%.

Marco D.: 100% complete at 2026-05-20T21:58:09Z. No holds triggered. Dedicated nodes pinned, agents stable. Closing D-2430.

Nate B.: Notes: small cost uptick +1.4%, no customer impact. Runbook updated with canary traces and kvcache prewarm steps. Thanks team! :party_popper:
